name: B10-0263/2025 (Renew) – Arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It strongly criticises Tanzania for arresting opposition leader Tundu Lissu on treason charges, which can carry the death penalty. It asks Tanzania to release him, drop the charges, free other political prisoners, let his party CHADEMA take part in the 2025 elections, and reform the electoral system. It also asks the European Union and its member states to watch the situation and consider measures if human rights keep getting worse.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests to Tanzania and the European Union.
- **Who it affects:** Tanzania's government, opposition leader Tundu Lissu, his party CHADEMA, and other political prisoners.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the resolution to Tanzania's president and government, the African Union, the East African Community, and European Union bodies.
